author: Marie Isabel de Monseignat
content: We were very pleased with the service we received from Dancing Cubs for the soft play ball pit and slide we have hired for our 3 year old son's birthddya, the items were delivered on time, set up properly, they kids absolutly loved it and they came back on time to pick the items back up, helped us tidying the balls back in their bag and the deposit was paid bakc the next day!
